instruction.text: Setze den Text zusammen, indem du die jeweils richtigen Satzenden auswählst.

atoms.a: When he grows up, Jonathan wants to become a musician
atoms.b: because he loves playing the guitar and singing.
atoms.sound: When he grows up Jonathan wants to become a musician because he loves playing the guitar and singing.

atoms.a: However, his parents would like him to study English
atoms.sound: However, his parents would like him to study English since he is talented in languages.

atoms.a: Jonathan says that he will decide for himself
atoms.b: as soon as he is old enough to know what's best for him.
atoms.sound: Jonathan says that he will decide for himself as soon as he is old enough to know what's best for him.

instruction.text: Ergänze den Dialog, indem du die Konjunktionen auf Englisch in die Lücken schreibst.

atoms.a: Michael, hattest du alle Aufgaben des Tests erledigt, als die Zeit vorbei war?
atoms.b: Michael, had you finished all the tasks in the test ((when)) the time was over?

atoms.a: Leider nicht, weil ich die dritte Aufgabe nicht lösen konnte.
atoms.b: Unfortunately not ((because)) I could not solve the third task.

atoms.a: Diese Aufgabe konnte ich lösen, aber ich hatte Probleme mit Nummer 5, obwohl ich genau das geübt hatte.
atoms.b: I was able to solve this task ((but)) I had problems with number 5 ((although even_though)) I had practised exactly that.

atoms.a: Das ist schade. Jedoch denke ich, dass das kein großes Problem ist, da es nur eine Aufgabe war, die du nicht lösen konntest.
atoms.b: That's a pity. However, I think ((that)) this is not a big problem ((since because)) it was only one task you couldn't solve.

atoms.a: Du hast recht. Wollen wir für den nächsten Test gemeinsam lernen, sodass wir dann perfekt vorbereitet sind?
atoms.b: You are right. Do you want to study together for the next test ((so_that)) we are perfectly prepared then?

atoms.a: Klar! Wir können uns bei mir treffen, falls du willst.
atoms.b: Sure! We can meet at my place ((if)) you want to.
